# dsh-checkdigit
Check-digit mathematics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, validate, repair and detect ch
eck digits for **19 schemes** — Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN-10, ISBN-13, EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, GTIN-1
4, ISSN, ISIN, CUSIP, **SEDOL**, IBAN, **CAS Registry Number**, **ABA routing number**, **NPI**, **L
EI** and **ORCID iD** — plus an **ISBN-10 ⇄ ISBN-13 converter**, a **single-edit repair search** ("w
hat was this number most likely meant to be?"), a **batch validator** for whole columns of identifie
rs and a **free-text scanner** that finds identifiers inside prose.
> 校验位数学工具箱：生成 / 验证 / 修复 / 识别 19 种校验位（Luhn、Verhoeff、Damm、ISBN、EAN、UPC、GTIN-14、ISSN、ISIN、CUSIP、SEDOL、I
BAN、CAS 化学文摘号、ABA 美国银行路由号、NPI 美国医疗提供者号、LEI 法人识别码、ORCID 学者号），另带 ISBN-10 与 ISBN-13 互转、「单字符修复」搜索工具、批量校验
工具与**自由文本扫描**工具；零运行时依赖、纯本地算术。
## Why
Language models routinely botch check-digit arithmetic: wrong card-number checksums, ISBNs that fail
validation, IBANs with impossible check digits. Every algorithm here is implemented from its publis
hed specification with **pure integer arithmetic** — deterministic, offline, zero runtime dependenci
es — and cross-checked against published worked examples (Apple's `US0378331005`, the classic `GB82
WEST 1234 5698 7654 32`, the Luhn textbook example `79927398713`, water's CAS number `7732-18-5`, an
4 5698 7654 32`, the Luhn textbook example `79927398713`, water's CAS number `7732-18-5`, and more).

o-activated, and restart dsh.
## Tools
### `checkdigit_generate`
Compute the check digit for a payload and return the complete identifier.

Use it to build test card numbers, ISBNs, barcodes, securities identifiers, routing numbers or accou
nt numbers whose check digits actually verify.
### `checkdigit_validate`
Verify the check digit of a full identifier. The scheme is auto-detected when omitted (CAS hyphenate
d → ISIN → 9-digit ABA → CUSIP → SEDOL (letter-leading) → IBAN → LEI (only when the mod-97 remainder
confirms it) → ORCID inside the `0000-000x` block → EAN-13 → UPC-A → ISSN (X-terminated) → EAN-8 →
ISBN-10 → Luhn); pass `scheme` to force one. SEDOLs that are all digits and every NPI share their le
ngth with Luhn/ISBN-10 values, so those two have to be named — and so does a sixteen-digit value out
side the ORCID block, which stays a card number.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Spaces, dashes and dots in the input are ignored (the spaced card form `4111 1111 1111 1111`, the hy
phenated `978-0-306-40615-7` and the printed `0378-5955` all validate). When a value is invalid, the
result carries the **expected** check digit so callers can fix it programmatically.
### `checkdigit_repair`
When a value fails, enumerate the **single-character edits that make it valid** — a corrected check
character, a swapped adjacent pair, or one mistyped payload character. Every repair is confirmed by
the scheme's own validator and ordered most-likely-first.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Both IBAN answers are legitimate — the caller can see whether the account digits or the check digits
were more likely mistyped. `total` always reports the full count; the returned list is capped at 20
(`truncated: true`).
### `checkdigit_batch`
Validate a whole column of identifiers in one call — 1 to 50 values, request order preserved. Each v
alue is auto-detected unless a `scheme` is given for the whole list, and the report carries one row
per value plus the counts and a per-scheme breakdown.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use it for pasted lists and spreadsheet columns instead of one validation call per row. An empty lis
t or more than 50 values is rejected with an `error` and no rows — the list is never truncated silen
more than 50 values is rejected with an `error` and no rows — the list is never truncated silently.
